list.title: Banking
list.description: Reconcilable accounts — import bank statements, match activity against the ledger, and sign off reconciliations.
list.emptyDescription: Mark your bank, card, and clearing accounts as reconcilable in the chart of accounts to start reconciling them here.

transactionsEmptyDescription: Write a check, record a card charge, or transfer funds between accounts.

account.description: {details} — import statements, then match and sign off.
account.statementsEmptyDescription: Import an OFX or CSV statement to bring this account's bank activity in.
account.reconciliationsEmptyDescription: Start a reconciliation with the bank statement's cutoff date and closing balance.

import.title: Import bank statement
import.description: Paste OFX or CSV text, or pick a file — it is read in your browser and imported as parsed lines.
import.importCount: Import {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
import.importedToast: {imported, plural, one {Imported # line} other {Imported # lines}}{duplicates, plural, =0 {} one { — # duplicate skipped} other { — # duplicates skipped}}
import.previewSummary: {imported, plural, one {# new line} other {# new lines}}{duplicates, plural, =0 {} one { · # duplicate skipped} other { · # duplicates skipped}}
import.mappingHelp: With a debit column mapped, Amount is treated as the credit (money-in) column and debits import negated. Ambiguous numeric dates are read as MM/DD/YYYY.
import.nothingNew: Every parsed line already exists on this account — nothing new to import.
import.moreLines: …and {count, plural, one {# more line} other {# more lines}}

start.title: Start reconciliation
start.description: Enter the bank statement's cutoff date and its closing balance — the workspace matches everything up to that date.

drawer.title: Statement {date}
drawer.deleteDraftBody: This permanently deletes the draft. This cannot be undone.
drawer.deletePostedBody: This permanently deletes the document and removes its ledger impact. This cannot be undone.

reconcile.title: Reconcile through {date}
reconcile.description: Match bank statement lines to posted journal lines until the difference is 0.00, then sign off.

workspace.signedOffAlert: This reconciliation is signed off — the matched journal lines below are permanently stamped as reconciled.
workspace.signOffDisabledTitle: Difference must be 0.00 to sign off
workspace.autoMatchedToast: {count, plural, one {Auto-matched # line} other {Auto-matched # lines}} ({high} high, {medium} medium confidence)
workspace.signOffConfirm: Sign off this reconciliation? Matched journal lines are stamped as reconciled — this cannot be undone.
workspace.signedOffToast: Signed off — {count, plural, one {# journal line reconciled} other {# journal lines reconciled}}
workspace.discardConfirm: Discard this reconciliation session? Its matches are undone and statement lines released.
workspace.noBankLinesSearch: No bank lines match this search.
workspace.allBankLinesMatched: Every statement line up to the cutoff is matched.
workspace.noGlLinesSearch: No ledger lines match this search.
workspace.allGlLinesReconciled: Every posted line up to the cutoff is reconciled or matched.
workspace.noMatchesSearch: No matches found for this search.
workspace.noMatchesYet: Nothing matched yet — run Auto-match or pair lines manually above.
workspace.adjustDescription: Change the cutoff date or the bank statement balance for this session.
